headline: Tools link cis-regulatory elements to target genes via multiomics and chromatin contacts
label: Plant Regulatory Omics Resources
summary: Recent releases extend plant regulatory resources to 240 species and add Hi-C-based target gene inference alongside interactive plant RNA-seq exploration.
synthesis: The common thread is computational infrastructure that converts regulatory and expression data into interpretable gene-level or network-level evidence. PlantPAN 5.0 integrates multiomics evidence across 240 plant species to build multilayered transcriptional regulatory networks. GOntact addresses cis-regulatory target assignment by using Promoter Capture Hi-C contacts to infer target genes and then derives GO enrichments for them. PlantTV provides interactive exploration of plant RNA-seq data, with differential expression, enrichment and co-expression views. DIANA-miRGen v5 applies a similar annotation logic to miRNAs, characterizing transcription start sites and host or promoter contexts in human and mouse using CLS long-read data, GENCODE and CAGE. What is new is the pairing of chromatin-contact-based target inference with curated multiomics networks and accessible browsing tools. The items do not report direct benchmarking against one another.
